posts.author: Godhand
posts.content_md:
Hello everyone!

I am new to holography and must admit I only discovered it 5 days ago, i have been awake reading as much as I can and would like to be involved in this process. I am a professional photographer who lives in the Hague in the Netherlands. I am searching for holographers to network with and just explore this form of art. Thanks

posts.author: Ed Wesly
posts.content_md: You should check out Walter Spierings at Dutch Holographic Laboratory in Eindhoven, [http://www.holoprint.com/](http://www.holoprint.com/) as he's been in the business for decades. For an interesting bunch of holography stuff, check out my site: [http://edweslystudio.com/](http://edweslystudio.com/) And of course there are plenty who will help you on this forum.
